expressions.name: Setpoints
expressions.expression:
// MVR setpoints + tuning. Temps degC, press psia. Heater outputs are PWM duty 0..1.
static.runSystem    = 0
static.timeIncSec   = 0.00625
static.sysMs        = 0      // system monotonic clock (ms) -- stamped by the server each tick (read-only to exprs)
static.lastTickMs   = 0      // sysMs at the previous tick (internal, for the real dt)
static.dtReal       = 0.00625 // REAL elapsed time since last tick (s) -- expression timing uses THIS, not timeIncSec
static.tickHz       = 0       // MEASURED evaluation rate (Hz, 5s EMA) -- the loop's actual speed vs the configured sample rate
static.evapPressSet = 14.7
static.evapTempSet  = 100.0
static.evapTempSetMin = 90      // SAFETY: evapTempSet within [this, evapTempSetMax]
static.evapTempSetMax = 110     // SAFETY: evapTempSet upper bound (over-pressure guard) degC
static.superheatSet = 3.0
static.superheatSetMax = 10     // SAFETY: superheatSet outside [0,this] ignored degC
static.blowerRpmSet = 1500
static.feedRpmSet   = 60
static.kpSuper  = 0.2    // SH P gain -- RIG-PROVEN at 0.2 (7/21): holds the setpoint much tighter. Safe at this level ONLY because of the guards added since the early duty-slam era: the +/-10C error clamp bounds P, the 250C element regulator caps the physical output, the flow FF carries the operating point (P handles residuals), and elem-limited sag doesn't count toward wet-comp
static.kiSuper  = 0.002
static.kShFF    = 0.03   // SH duty FEEDFORWARD per 1000rpm of blower: the duty operating point scales with vapor mass flow (rig: 0.05 held 5C at 1500rpm; the same duty is nothing at 4000 -- superheat sagged into the trip while the soft PI crawled). FF carries the operating point, the PI only trims
static.kpMakeup = 0.5    // RETUNED again (rig 7/14 pm): user ran 0.7/0.07 -- fast but a 42s +/-1.2C limit cycle against the ~10s TC lag. 0.5/0.03 + the new FEED SLEW LIMIT (the real disturbance was cold-water rushes) is the balance; push up if sluggish
static.kiMakeup = 0.03
static.surgeThresh = 1.0      // degC dT below which the bypass starts opening
static.surgeGain   = 5.0      // V per degC of surge
static.condLevelThresh = 2.5
static.demisterThresh  = 2.5    // (deprecated -- demister now uses cc thresholds below)
static.demisterTripML  = 80     // demister DRAIN pump ON at this accumulated water (cc) -- measured trip
static.demisterResetML = 5      // drain pump OFF here (cc) -- hysteresis so it can't chatter
static.demisterPumpMlMin = 500  // demister drain peristaltic pump rate (ml/min)
static.demisterFloodML = 150    // flood/overflow trip level (cc) -- drain can't keep up
static.demisterAccumHot  = 4    // demister water accumulation when hot/steady (cc/min)
static.demisterAccumCold = 60   // extra accumulation while warming (cc/min, scales with how far below boiling)
static.demisterDrainOn = 0      // drain pump state (hysteresis latch)
static.demisterDrainRunS = 12   // demister drain MIN run (s) once the wet/dry sensor trips -- clears it below the sensor (no chatter)
static.demisterDrainSec  = 0    // demister drain run timer (s)
static.maxEvapPress    = 25.0
static.maxSteamPress   = 35.0
// ---- POWER METER (PowerMeter expr): heater ratings x duty + VFD-reported
// blower W + small fixed loads -> instantaneous powerW and energyKWh totalizer
static.pwrMakeupW    = 2000     // makeup cartridge rated W (x makeupDuty)
static.pwrSuperW     = 300      // superheat cartridge rated W (x superDuty)
static.pwrCondW      = 20       // condensate pump W while condPumpOn
static.pwrMistW      = 20       // demister drain pump W while draining
static.pwrFeedW      = 30       // feed stepper W while commanded
static.pwrBaseW      = 30       // electronics + supplies W (always on)
static.powerW        = 0        // INSTANTANEOUS total electrical power (W)
static.energyKWh     = 0        // ENERGY TOTALIZER (kWh) -- reset by the resetEnergyCalcs button (or a Static Var widget)
static.energyProdL   = 0        // PRODUCT TOTALIZER for the energy window (L, calibrated meter flow) -- reset by the same button so kWh and L cover the SAME window
static.specKWhL      = 0        // SPECIFIC ENERGY (kWh per L) over the window since reset -- THE MVR figure of merit (resistive distillation ~0.63; target ~0.1-0.15)
// ---- WET-COMP AUTO-RESTART (rig 7/22): the trip cuts blower+heat, flow stops,
// superheat re-establishes, and a warm resume is gentle -- it recovers well
// every time. So recover AUTOMATICALLY: clear the latch after a cooldown,
// bounded attempts per run; re-arming still requires superheat re-established.
static.shAutoRstEn   = 1        // 1 = auto-clear wet-compression trips
static.shAutoRstS    = 45       // cooldown before the auto-clear (s): let the pipe drain/settle
static.shAutoRstMax  = 3        // attempts per run -- a trip that keeps coming back deserves an operator
static.shRstT        = 0        // cooldown timer (s)
static.shRstCnt      = 0        // attempts used this run
static.minSuperheat    = 0.5
static.superHFaultS    = 20     // wet-comp trip DEBOUNCE (s): superheat must sit below minSuperheat this long CONTINUOUSLY at speed+temp -- swings dip briefly, wet compression persists (rig 7/13 false trip)
static.superHSec       = 0      // wet-comp debounce timer (s)
static.shElemLim     = 0        // 1 = SH duty is being LIMITED by the element-temp regulator (set in SuperheatControl): the cartridge is at ~200C and physically can't push more heat -- a superheat sag in this state is a CAPABILITY limit, not wet compression (mesh at 200C can't be drowning), so it must not count toward the trip
static.superheatGraceTemp = 90   // superheat interlock only arms once evap > this (no cold-start trip)
static.maxVaporOut     = 140.0
static.makeupHtrMax    = 140     // HARD trip backstop: makeup-cartridge TC the fold-back couldn't hold (degC)
static.makeupHtrSoft   = 115     // element TC SOFT limit: fold the heater PWM back above this (violent boil / local dry) degC
static.makeupHtrFoldBand = 15    // fold-back band (degC): duty scales 1->0 from makeupHtrSoft to +this
static.makeupHtrMinDuty = 0.12   // keep-warm PWM floor the fold-back won't drop below (just holds vapor ~100C) -- TUNE
static.superHtrMax     = 275    // SAFETY trip: superheat-cartridge TC over-temp degC -- BACKSTOP above the 250C element regulation (the cartridge couples poorly into thin vapor and runs HOT by design)
static.superHtrRegC    = 250    // SH cartridge ELEMENT-TEMP regulation target (degC): the duty is capped so the element holds here until real vapor flow carries the heat away (then the superheat PI takes over). Raised 200->250 per rig: at 200 it couldn't keep up with the vapor flow
static.kpShElem        = 0.05   // element-temp regulator P gain (duty per degC below superHtrRegC): full duty 20C below target, zero at target
static.productionSet = 0.12     // TARGET distillate rate (L/min) -- blower + feed chase this
static.prodSetMax    = 0.5      // SAFETY clamp: productionSet inputs outside [0,this] are IGNORED. Raised 0.3 -> 0.5 (7/21): the rig MEASURED 0.43 L/min -- the old clamp silently rejected productionSet=0.4 (prodSetSafe stuck at 0.3, nothing visibly changed)
static.feedLPerStep  = 0.0000000896861 // FEED PUMP CAL -- liters delivered per motor STEP (peristaltic)
static.feedStepsPerRev = 10000  // motor steps/rev (match driver microstep Pr0.00); L/min = rpm*stepsPerRev*LPerStep
static.feedPrimeML   = 750      // PRIME fill target (ml) = EvapLow mark: heater covered, confirm wet, THEN heat (feed ramps to operating during warm-up)
static.feedPrimeRpm  = 400      // feed pump motor rpm during the startup prime fill. Rig DOLILO 7/21: 250 -> 400
static.emptying      = 0        // EMPTY/SHUTDOWN drain active (button vars emptySystem or shutdown, only while stopped)
static.emptyDone     = 0        // empty completed -- latched until the button is released
static.purgeRevRpm   = 400      // STARTUP PURGE: feed pump REVERSE rpm (~359 mL/min -- empties the feed/evap side fast)
static.purgeMaxML    = 2000     // PURGE backstop (ml): blind reverse-pump cap, used only if the level sender is faulted (normally PURGE stops when the sender reads bottom)
static.emptyMaxML    = 4000     // EMPTY/SHUTDOWN drain backstop (ml): must exceed a FULL operating charge (~2.5L) + purgeExtraML -- purgeMaxML is sized for the startup residual and cut the drain short
static.purgeExtraML  = 200      // after the sender reads BOTTOM (plateau 0), keep reverse-pumping this much more (ml, dead-reckoned) -- water below the float pickup is still in there
static.purgeZeroML   = -1       // purgeOutML captured when the sender first read bottom this purge (-1 = not yet). CONSTANT init (an expression here would re-run EVERY tick and wipe the mark)
static.purgeEmptyML  = 50       // SIM: feed side counts as empty below this evaporator inventory (ml)
static.purgeOutML    = 0        // PURGE state: cumulative ml pumped back out this purge
static.yFeedEmpty    = 0        // input level detector: 1 = feed/evap side is empty (real sensor; sim from inventory)
static.feedRpmMax    = 425      // SAFETY/HW: max feed pump (stepper) rpm -- manual + auto clamp. Rig DOLILO 7/21: 300 -> 425 (375 also fine) -- at 0.4+ L/min production the feed must sustain ~400rpm just to match boil-off
static.feedMinLpm    = 0.03     // MINIMUM RUN FEED (L/min, ~33rpm): the cold feed IS the subcooler's heat sink -- at feed 0 nothing condenses, production reads 0, the level never drops, and level control correctly asks for... 0 feed (rig 7/15 log 144158: 8min at feed 0, prod 0.003, level frozen at set). A trickle keeps the condensing path alive; the high-level cut still overrides
static.feedSlewRpmS  = 15       // AUTO-FEED SLEW LIMIT (rpm/s): the feed slammed 0..450rpm on production-measure jumps, and every slam is a cold-water RUSH the makeup PI then chases (the 42s eT limit cycle). Level control is slow anyway -- rate-limit the command. Rig DOLILO 7/21: 10 -> 15
static.autoBlow      = 1        // 1 = blower auto-trims to hold productionSet
static.autoFeed      = 1        // 1 = feed pump tracks production (mass balance)
static.kProd         = 20       // blower production-control gain (rpm per L/min-error-second)
static.kProdDown     = 4        // OVERSHOOT UNWIND multiplier (rig 7/21): production above set falls at kProd*kProdDown -- the symmetric 2rpm/s took ~6min to unwind 2860->2100 while the boiler oversold 30%
static.kProdBand     = 0.03     // RAISE DEADBAND (L/min): stop climbing within this of set -- in-flight momentum + measurement lag close the rest (the pure integral kept climbing on stale data and overshot every approach)
static.blowerMinRpm  = 800      // blower ABSOLUTE floor (wet-comp at-speed gate etc.)
static.blowerRunMinRpm = 1950   // production-control TURNDOWN floor: once RUNNING the target never drops below this (rig: below ~2000 there is no real vapor flow -- superheat dies and progress unwinds)
static.blowerMaxRpm  = 3500     // blower clamp (max). Lowered from 4000 (rig 7/15): in the stuck-hot deadlock the integral wound to 4000 and just churned the same steam hotter -- above ~3500 there is nothing to gain
static.vaporOutSoft  = 115      // blower VAPOR-OUT fold-back (degC): above this the target BACKS OFF proportionally and raises pause (hysteresis: raises resume below this-5). Lowered 120->115: with the condenser bleed working the discharge climbs 20C in 30s -- 120 let a 142C spike reach the 140 trip (rig 7/15 pm)
static.prodStallLpm  = 0.03     // production-STALL threshold (L/min): RUN production below this at temp = something is choking condensation
static.prodStallS    = 300      // ...for this long -> pulse the vent (air-accumulation purge). Repeats every prodStallS while stalled
static.ventPulseS    = 30       // stall vent-pulse length (s): dumps the non-condensable blanket off the condensing surface (feed water carries dissolved air in CONTINUOUSLY -- the once-per-run purge can't remove what arrives later)
static.ventStallT    = 0        // stall timer (s)
static.ventFitted    = 0        // 1 = a powered vent valve is PLUMBED (DO:VentValve does something). 0 (rig 7/22 reality): only the always-open needle bleed at the HX-output bottom -- the vent state machine is then BYPASSED (ventOpen never latches 1), because a phantom 'venting' state boosts the blower, freezes production control, and DISARMS the superheat rescue while no valve exists (that combination built the 7/22 wet-comp trip). Sim always models the vent. Set 1 when the powered vent lands at the HX bottom
static.ventReliefC   = 125      // THERMAL RELIEF vent (degC): above this vapor-out, OPEN the vent regardless of ventDone -- dump the superheated charge and pull fresh saturated vapor through. Closes at this -10. The manual remedy that recovered the rig, automated
static.ventRelief    = 0        // thermal-relief hysteresis latch
static.blowerStartTemp = 90     // blower START gate: stays OFF below this evap temp (cold evaporator has no vapor to pump)
static.blowerStopTemp  = 80     // blower STOP gate once RUNNING (hysteresis): the pipe TC hovers near 90 with flow, so cutting at blowerStartTemp limit-cycled the blower on the rig (7/13) -- once running only a real collapse below this stops it
static.blowerRampRpm0 = 200     // blower soft-start rpm once the temp gate opens
static.blowerRampRpmS = 10      // blower ramp rate (rpm/s) while the evaporator is still WARMING (gentle: thin vapor)
static.blowerRampHotS = 50
static.ventBoostRpm  = 2500
static.evapPressMin  = 13.0     // suction-pressure FLOOR (psia): evap pressure below this = the blower is outpacing the boil (capability ceiling) -> the target stops climbing and backs off. The honest 'how fast can we go' signal
static.blowerSeekRpmS = 25
static.tsatTrimC     = 2.0      // TSAT ALIGNMENT TRIM (degC, ADDED to both computed Tsats): TCs + pressure transducers each carry small offsets -- rig 7/14 measured ~1.4; DOLILO 7/21 running value 2.0 adopted as default (re-derive after the TC/PT zero cal). CALIBRATE: at a vigorous VENTED boil set tsatTrimC = yEvapTemp - evapTsat. Cancels in deltaT; shifts superheatIn down by the trim
static.deltaTMin     = 2.5      // MINIMUM COMPRESSION LIFT (degC): deltaT = steamTsat - evapTsat is the MVR's working head -- at ~1C the HX moves no heat, nothing condenses, and the sealed system just pressurizes (rig 7/14: both pressures climbing together at 1500rpm). Below this the blower target RAISES
static.feedStallRpm  = 200      // feed-stall watch arms above this commanded feed rpm (fill-rate; the normal hold runs well below)
static.feedStallMaxML = 1500    // FEED-STALL fault: this much feed dead-reckoned at fill rate WITHOUT the sender stepping UP one plateau -> the pump is not delivering (empty supply/tubing/stepper) or the sender is stuck. Latches evapLevelErr (trip + popup). Rig 7/14: 300rpm for 15min, ~4L commanded, level frozen, vessel slowly pressurizing
static.feedStallML   = 0        // dead-reckoned feed since the last UPWARD plateau step (ml)
static.blowerSeekMaxRpm = 2800
static.ventPrev      = 0        // ventOpen last tick (vent-close edge detect for the boost hand-off)  // PRESSURE-SEEK CEILING: the rig makes enough vapor that suction never sags -- the seek ran to the 4000 clamp (7/13). The seek's job is only 'don't sit at the nominal'; production control does the fine trim after batches       // PRESSURE-SEEK climb rate (rpm/s): after the vent closes but BEFORE the first condensate batch there is no measured production yet -- climb the blower target while the suction holds, instead of sitting frozen at the nominal (rig 7/13: stuck at 1500; it runs better at 2000-3000)     // VENT-PURGE BOOST: blower target while the startup vent is still open (at temp) -- at the nominal 1500 the vapor mass flow is too thin to heat the discharge path and VaporOut crawls (rig 7/13: 65->84C in 14min, vent never closed). Boost shoves mass through, VaporOut hits ventCloseTemp fast, then the target drops back to blowerRpmSet      // blower ramp rate (rpm/s) once the evaporator is AT TEMP (>= set-3): boil-off can keep up, no reason to crawl (200->1500 in ~26s)
static.blowerCmdRpm  = 0        // rate-limited blower command (the ONLY rpm sent to the VFD)
static.blowdownFrac  = 0        // NO blowdown valve fitted -> feed exactly matches distillate. Solids concentrate over a run; drain/flush the evaporator periodically (manual blowdown). Set >0 only if a real bleed/drain is added.
static.ventOpenTemp  = 97       // STARTUP AIR-PURGE vent: OPEN below this blower-out vapor temp (purge non-condensables while warming). Raised back 92->97 with the blower insulated
static.ventCloseTemp = 100      // vent CLOSES once blower-out vapor reaches this. 95 was for the uninsulated blower (vO never reached 101); insulated it passes 100 easily, and closing at 95 left the air purge INCOMPLETE (rig 7/15: 1.5-3 psi of air blanketing the condenser)
static.trimHX        = 0        // 1 = feedwater-cooled trim condenser fitted just before the flow meter
static.prodPerRpm    = 0.00007  // production estimate (L/min) per blower rpm -- calibrate to your blower
static.evapLevelSet  = 2475     // operating level = evapMidMark (~2.5L plateau edge)
static.kFeedLevel    = 0.015    // feed level PROPORTIONAL gain (L/min per ml of fused-level error) -- bench-tuned, ~10x the I gain
static.levelPMax     = 0.08     // LEVEL-P CONTRIBUTION CAP (L/min): 0.015 x a plateau hop = 4-5 L/min demanded -> the feed slammed 0..400rpm, each slam a cold slug that swung VaporIn 99..122C, superheat with it, and the blower fold/raise behind that -- THE 190s slow roll (and its wet-comp trip). Level correction is a TRIM; feedFF carries production
static.kFeedLevelI   = 0.0015   // feed level INTEGRAL gain (L/min per s) -- slow bias trim, ~1/10 of P
static.levelDeadML   = 100      // P deadband (ml) around the setpoint: P silent inside (the edge-ride integral rules), active outside. Widening to 250 was tried (7/15) and REVERTED: the system just settled at the deadband edge, 250ml low -- P is the only restoring force out there. The SLAM fix is levelPMax, not the deadband
static.feedFillLpm   = 0.20     // warm-up FILL rate (L/min) when far below the operating mark
static.feedBaseTau   = 240      // ADAPTIVE FEED BASE learn horizon (s): slow EMA of the COMMANDED feed. The level is held in a band, so the long-run average feed IS the balance rate -- measured on the calibrated pump side, immune to meter cal error and prodFast burst noise
static.feedBaseRampS = 600      // confidence ramp (s of RUN time): the FF blend weight and override softening reach full strength (0.7) over this -- fresh runs start with the old aggressive behavior and relax as the base proves itself
static.feedBaseLpm   = 0        // learned balance feed rate (L/min); retained across stop/start, reset by recompile
static.feedBaseT     = 0        // RUN time accumulated toward the confidence ramp (s)
static.feedHighRawML = 100      // RAW-HIGH THROTTLE margin (ml): in RUN, raw sender ABOVE evapLevelSet plus this (= the sender stepped onto the plateau above the operating edge, 2600) caps the feed at HALF production-match so the level drifts back down NOW -- waiting for the 2750 warn meant coasting over it every time
static.feedLowRawML  = 300      // RAW-LOW OVERRIDE margin (ml): in RUN, raw sender below evapLevelSet minus this (>= one plateau genuinely LOW) forces fill-rate feed over every cap/fold. Rig 7/21 restart: estimates and trim caps held the feed at 98rpm while 0.6 L/min pumped out -- the sender said LOW and low means LOW
static.fillStopML    = 200      // HEAT fill stops this far BELOW the operating mark: the fill is COLD water that expands ~4% to boiling, plus the slew-limited pump decel keeps delivering -- filling to the mark itself overshot into the 2750 high warn EVERY startup. Expansion + RUN's capped-P top-off close the gap gently
static.simLevelBobML = 30       // SIM: float bob from the boil (ml RMS) on the sender reading
static.senderSpanML  = 200      // fusion window half-width (ml): true level within +/- this of the decoded plateau center (plateau spans ~200-350ml near operating)
static.senderOK      = 0        // sender voltage in valid range (SensorMux); out of range = open/short -> switches dry, fusion frozen
static.senderFaultS  = 2        // sender out-of-range must persist this long (s) while running -> senderErr TRIP
static.senderFaultSec = 0       // sender-fault debounce timer (s)
static.senderErr     = 0        // LATCHED sender-fault trip (open/short mid-run); clears on stop
static.purgeStallS   = 240      // PURGE watchdog (s): if the sender level hasn't DROPPED a plateau in this long, the pump isn't emptying (direction/pump fault) -> trip
static.purgeStallSec = 0        // purge-stall timer (s)
static.purgeLvlPrev  = 0        // sender level at the last observed drop (watchdog reference)
static.purgeErr      = 0        // LATCHED purge-stall fault; clears on stop
static.purgeWarmEn   = 1        // 1 = WARM-START purge: sender shows water at run start -> pump down until the level has dropped AT LEAST ONE plateau (the drop-edge crossing calibrates the estimate) AND reads at/below the operating mark (covers a restart from an overfull shutdown), then start from there. 0 = always purge to dry
static.purgeWarm     = 0        // this purge is a warm start (latched at run start)
static.purgeStartLvl = 0        // decoded plateau (ml) at purge entry -- the warm-start drop reference
static.haveEvapLevel = 0        // 1 = analog level sender fitted -- SET IN SENSORMUX (sim=1; real=0 until wired)
static.yEvapSenderV  = 0        // sender voltage, SCALED (AI6 slope -1.0 / offset ~3.68): DRY = 0V rising to ~3.0V full. KEEP that AI scaling -- the cal table below is in these volts
static.yEvapLevRaw   = 0        // decoded level (ml) from the MEASURED cal table (plateau centers; ~14 steps, NONLINEAR arm/tank geometry)
static.levelStepPrev = -1       // fusion state: last step index (-1 = no reading yet)
static.levelBiasLpm  = 0        // LEARNED level-rate bias (L/min): the observer's estimate of the meter/model error, learned from anchor innovations
static.kLevelBias    = 0.0003   // bias-learning gain (L/min per mL of anchor innovation)
static.feedLevelTrim = 0        // feed level-integral state (L/min)
static.evapLowMark   = 750      // LOW mark (ml): heater-covered / prime wet-confirm. Sits on the 587|850 plateau edge (physical ~720)
static.evapMidMark   = 2475     // OPERATING mark (ml) = the 2350|2600 plateau edge (2.22V|2.39V) ~ 2.5L. Lowered from 3025: thermal expansion (~4% cold->boiling) + wobble took the 3/4 fill over the top on the rig
static.evapHighWarnS = 3        // high-level WARN debounce (s): the float bobs ~30ml RMS, so a true ~2650 level occasionally FLICKS the reading onto the 2900 plateau for a sample -- the latched warning needs persistence. The yEvapHigh FEED CUT stays instantaneous
static.evapHighSec   = 0        // high-level warn debounce timer (s)
static.feedRecentLpm = 0        // recent-feed EMA (L/min, 60s): the SWELL DISCRIMINATOR -- a high reading with no recent feed is froth, not overfill
static.feedWarnLpm   = 0.05     // high-level WARN requires recent feed above this: rig 7/22 both 'obnoxious' warns fired with the feed at 0-8rpm while boil swell walked the reading over the 2750 edge (cold start hit raw 3150 with the feed OFF). The feed CUT on yEvapHigh stays unconditional -- only the popup is qualified
static.evapHighClrS  = 60       // warn AUTO-CLEAR (s): the latched warning clears after the level reads non-high continuously this long (was latched until STOP -- lit on the startup expansion bob and then glowed all run)
static.evapHighClrT  = 0        // warn auto-clear timer (s)
static.evapHighMark  = 2750     // HIGH-LEVEL WARNING (ml): the 2600|2900 plateau edge -- trips when the reading hits the 2900 plateau (~2.75L physical). Per rig: 2.7L is high, 2.9 way high
static.simSpillML    = 3800     // SIM: sender-referenced level where overfill SPILLS into the demister (past totally-full 3.6L + fittings ~3.8-4L)
static.evapLevelCheckML = 1000  // PRIME CHECK: if we've dead-reckoned this much fill and EvapLow is still DRY -> fault (feed-pump or sensor failure)


// ===== MVR SIMULATOR params + one-time state init (top-level consts = init once) =====
static.simEnable     = 0        // 0 = real AI/TC, 1 = run the MVR simulator
static.simDriveHW    = 0        // in sim: 0 = dry (no real outputs), 1 = drive hardware (HIL)
static.simSpeed      = 120      // sim time accel (x real). Higher = faster dynamics
static.simAmbient    = 25       // degC ambient
static.simFeedSupply = 18       // degC cold feed water
static.simCevap      = 60000    // evaporator thermal mass (sets warm-up LAG)
static.simMakeupPow  = 2000     // makeup/startup heater W at duty 1 (real heater)
static.simSuperPow   = 300      // superheat cartridge W at duty 1 (real heater)
static.simSteamCp     = 2000    // steam specific heat (J/kg/degC) for the superheat calc
static.simSHmeshEff   = 0.4     // fraction of SH-heater W the copper mesh puts into the steam
static.simUAsteam    = 1500     // HX -> evaporator heat recovery (W/degC)
static.simChx        = 14000    // HX thermal mass: 24 lb steel + ~2L water (J/degC)
static.simUAloss     = 3        // ambient/standby heat loss (W/degC) -- insulated rig
static.simPRmax      = 1.25     // blower full-speed pressure ratio (PR)
static.simCompGain   = 60       // compression superheat on VaporOut (degC per PR-1)
static.simBlowerRated = 3450    // blower rated rpm
static.simTauBlower  = 2.0      // blower spin-up / vapor-out time const (s)
static.simTauP       = 3.0      // evaporator pressure response (s)
static.simTauSH      = 5.0      // superheat response (s)
static.simHtrCoverML  = 550     // makeup cartridge covered above this inventory (ml): inlet 0.5L tube +0.12L fittings -0.069L heater, element top ~9.5in up
static.simMakeupCovRise = 3    // makeup cartridge surface rise per duty when COVERED (degC)
static.simMakeupRise  = 150     // extra makeup surface rise per duty when UNCOVERED (degC)
static.simSuperRise   = 300     // superheat cartridge surface rise per duty (degC)
static.simTauHtr      = 3.0     // cartridge surface thermal response (s)
// sim state (updated every tick by MVRSim; init once here so SensorMux has
// valid values from tick 1)
static.simEvapTemp   = 25
static.simEvapPress  = 14.7  // starts at atmospheric (air-filled, vented); lifts only near boiling
static.simSteamPress = 14.7
static.simAtmPress   = 14.7  // SIM: atmospheric / vent reference (psia) -- non-condensable air holds the
                             //      evaporator here until Psat(eT) exceeds it at boiling; steam side = this x PR
static.simVaporIn    = 25
static.simVaporOut   = 25
static.simSteamChest = 25
static.simHXbottom   = 25
static.simCondTemp   = 25
static.simFeedTemp   = 18
static.simMakeupHtrTemp = 25
static.simSuperHtrTemp  = 25
static.simSuperheat  = 0
static.simBlowerRpm  = 0
static.simCondLevel  = 1.0
static.simCondFlow   = 0
static.simDemisterWater = 0
static.simDemisterFlood = 0
static.simProd       = 0
// --- realism: surge / noise / condensate tank + self-calibrating flow meter ---
static.simClock       = 0      // accumulating sim-seconds (surge/noise phase)

// ---- REAL delta-time from the system millisecond clock. The server stamps its
// monotonic clock into static.sysMs each tick BEFORE evaluate; differencing it here
// gives the ACTUAL elapsed time, so every expression's timing (PI integrals,
// debounces, windows, the sim dt) is accurate instead of assuming the nominal tick
// period. Guards cover the first ticks + any scheduling hiccup (fall back to nominal). ----
dtRealS = (static.sysMs - static.lastTickMs) / 1000
static.lastTickMs = static.sysMs
if ( dtRealS <= 0 ) then
    dtRealS = static.timeIncSec
endif
if ( dtRealS > 0.1 ) then
    dtRealS = 0.1                  // hiccup CLAMP (was: substitute the 6.25ms nominal -- a 200ms stall then undercounted time by ~194ms; capping at 100ms loses the least)
endif
static.dtReal = dtRealS

// harmless because everything integrates on dtReal, but the truth belongs on
// the layout: chart/display static.tickHz)
static.tickHz = static.tickHz + (1 / dtRealS - static.tickHz) * clamp(dtRealS / 5, 0, 1)

expressions.name: SensorMux
expressions.expression:
// ===== SENSOR MUX =====
// Every sensor is abstracted as static.yXxx. simEnable=1 -> controllers read the
// MVR simulator (sim* from MVRSim); simEnable=0 -> real AI/TC (identical to the
// original rig behavior). Block IF (not inline) for transpiler safety.
sim = static.simEnable
if ( sim ) then
    static.yEvapPress     = static.simEvapPress
    static.ySteamPress    = static.simSteamPress
    static.yVaporIn       = static.simVaporIn
    static.yVaporOut      = static.simVaporOut
    static.yEvapTemp      = static.simEvapTemp
    static.yMakeupHtrTemp = static.simMakeupHtrTemp
    static.ySuperHtrTemp  = static.simSuperHtrTemp
    static.yDemisterFlood = static.simDemisterFlood
    static.yDemisterWater = static.simDemisterWater >= static.demisterTripML
    static.yCondLevel     = static.simCondHigh
    static.yCondTemp      = static.simCondTemp
    static.yCondHigh      = static.simCondHigh
    static.yCondLow       = static.simCondLow
    static.yCondTotal     = static.simCondTotal
    static.yEvapSenderV   = static.simEvapSenderV
    static.haveEvapLevel  = 1
    static.yEvapLevelML   = static.feedInvEst   // NO evaporator level sensor (physical) -> control uses the calibrated feed-pump dead-reckon even in sim
    static.yFeedEmpty     = static.simEvapInv < static.purgeEmptyML
else
    static.yEvapPress     = "AI:EvapPress"
    static.ySteamPress    = "AI:SteamPress"
    static.yVaporIn       = "TC:VaporIn"
    static.yVaporOut      = "TC:VaporOut"
    static.yEvapTemp      = "TC:SteamChest"   // the evap->demister PIPE TC is physically wired to the SteamChest input (ch5); saturated vapor = boiling temp. ch1 EvapTemp is unpopulated
    static.yMakeupHtrTemp = "TC:MakeupHtr"
    static.ySuperHtrTemp  = "TC:SuperHtr"
    static.yDemisterFlood = "AI:DemisterFlood" > 2.5
    static.yDemisterWater = "AI:DemisterWater" > 2.5
    static.yCondLevel     = "AI:CondLevel" > 2.5
    static.yCondTotal     = "CTR:CondTotal"
    static.yCondTemp      = "TC:CondTemp"
    // real: derive HIGH/LOW from the single analog level (hysteresis band)
    // until two physical level switches are wired.
    static.yCondHigh      = "AI:CondLevel" > static.condLevelThresh
    static.yCondLow       = "AI:CondLevel" > (static.condLevelThresh - 0.5)
    static.yEvapSenderV   = "AI:EvapLevel"   // the tank-gauge sender (AI6) IS the level sensing -- the sight-glass switches are gone
    static.haveEvapLevel  = 1
    static.yEvapLevelML   = static.feedInvEst   // no analog evaporator-level sensor (EvapLevel is wet/dry) -> dead-reckon
    static.yFeedEmpty     = 0      // no input level detector wired yet -> NOT empty, so PURGE runs the dead-reckon backstop (purgeMaxML). Wire it here: 1 = feed side empty.
endif

// ---- tank-gauge sender decode: the MEASURED calibration table (MVR Level Cal.csv).
// Level-vs-ohms is strongly NONLINEAR (arm-swing float + tank geometry), so the
// linear travel model is gone: the scaled voltage (AI6 slope -1.0/offset ~3.68,
// dry=0V) maps straight to the measured plateau centers. ~14 steps, uh-oh-full=3600.
// Valid range check: open sender wire -> big NEGATIVE scaled V; short -> ~3.68.
static.senderOK = static.haveEvapLevel and (static.yEvapSenderV > (0 - 0.3)) and (static.yEvapSenderV < 3.3)
doDecode = static.senderOK
if ( doDecode ) then
    sv = static.yEvapSenderV
    lv = 0
    if ( sv >= 0.275 ) then
        lv = 200
    endif
    if ( sv >= 0.875 ) then
        lv = 300
    endif
    if ( sv >= 1.265 ) then
        lv = 587
    endif
    if ( sv >= 1.395 ) then
        lv = 850
    endif
    if ( sv >= 1.53 ) then
        lv = 1200
    endif
    if ( sv >= 1.67 ) then
        lv = 1500
    endif
    if ( sv >= 1.815 ) then
        lv = 1900
    endif
    if ( sv >= 1.97 ) then
        lv = 2100
    endif
    if ( sv >= 2.135 ) then
        lv = 2350
    endif
    if ( sv >= 2.305 ) then
        lv = 2600
    endif
    if ( sv >= 2.49 ) then
        lv = 2900
    endif
    if ( sv >= 2.69 ) then
        lv = 3150
    endif
    if ( sv >= 2.895 ) then
        lv = 3500
    endif
    static.yEvapLevRaw = lv
    // level switches from the decoded plateau -- marks sit on measured plateau EDGES
    static.yEvapLow  = static.yEvapLevRaw >= static.evapLowMark
    static.yEvapMid  = static.yEvapLevRaw >= static.evapMidMark
    static.yEvapHigh = (static.dinEvapHigh > 0.5) or (static.yEvapLevRaw >= static.evapHighMark)
endif
if ( static.senderOK == 0 ) then
    // sender fault/unwired: everything reads DRY (no heat possible); DIN can still warn.
    // (gauge-invalid under suction is different: the reading + switches HOLD above.)
    static.yEvapLow  = 0
    static.yEvapMid  = 0
    static.yEvapHigh = static.dinEvapHigh > 0.5
endif

expressions.name: SteamTables
expressions.expression:
// Saturation temps (Antoine, high range) + superheat. Tsat(P_psia) -> degC.
ep = static.yEvapPress
sp = static.ySteamPress
VaporIn = static.yVaporIn
VaporOut = static.yVaporOut
static.PressRatio = sp/ep
pressRatio = static.PressRatio

epmm = ep * 51.7149
if (epmm < 0) then
    epmm = 0
endif

spmm = sp * 51.7149
if (spmm < 0) then
    spmm = 0
endif

evapTsat  = 1810.94 / (8.14019 - log(epmm) / 2.302585) - 244.485
steamTsat = 1810.94 / (8.14019 - log(spmm) / 2.302585) - 244.485
// TSAT ALIGNMENT TRIM: see tsatTrimC in Setpoints (calibrate at a vented boil)
evapTsat = evapTsat + static.tsatTrimC
steamTsat = steamTsat + static.tsatTrimC
static.evapTsat     = evapTsat
static.steamTsat    = steamTsat
static.superheatIn  = VaporIn  - evapTsat
static.superheatOut = VaporOut - steamTsat
static.deltaT       = steamTsat - evapTsat

expressions.name: Interlocks
expressions.expression:
// Safety interlocks -> heatOK / trip / alarm / HeaterEnable.
evapPress    = static.yEvapPress
steamPress   = static.ySteamPress
superHIn     = static.superheatIn
vaporOutTemp = static.yVaporOut
// flood QUALIFIED by the demister-water sensor: flood physically sits ABOVE the
// demist sensor, so a genuine flood ALWAYS has DemisterWater wet too. Fog/condensation
// films the flood sensor alone -> without this gate it false-tripped on the rig.
flood = (static.yDemisterFlood > 0.5) and (static.yDemisterWater > 0.5)
static.floodTrip = flood
// EVAPORATOR LEVEL / PRIME VERIFY: by the time we have dead-reckoned
// evapLevelCheckML of feed into the evaporator, the EvapLevel sensor MUST read
// wet. If it is still dry the feed pump isn't moving water or the sensor is dead
// -> latch a fault (blocks heat; the UI pops 'Evaporator Level Error'). PRIME only.
evapLvlErr = static.evapLevelErr
if ( (static.mvrPhase == 2) and (static.feedInvEst >= static.evapLevelCheckML) and (static.yEvapLow < 0.5) ) then
    evapLvlErr = 1
endif
if ( static.feedStallML >= static.feedStallMaxML ) then
    evapLvlErr = 1    // FEED STALL: fill-rate feed with no upward sender step (rig 7/14: 4L commanded, level frozen)
endif
if ( static.runSystem == 0 ) then
    evapLvlErr = 0
endif
static.evapLevelErr = evapLvlErr
// LEVEL SENDER FAULT: the sender is THE level sensing -- raw 0V (short/no supply) or
// ~10V (broken wire, ADC rail) reads far outside the valid scaled range and senderOK
// drops. Debounced + LATCHED trip: without it a mid-run fault reads 'all dry' and the
// level integral would slow-flood to the demister. Clears on stop.
sdt = static.dtReal
if ( static.simEnable ) then
    sdt = static.dtReal * static.simSpeed
endif
if ( static.runSystem and (static.mvrPhase >= 2) and (static.senderOK < 0.5) ) then
    static.senderFaultSec = static.senderFaultSec + sdt
else
    static.senderFaultSec = 0
endif
sErr = static.senderErr
if ( static.senderFaultSec > static.senderFaultS ) then
    sErr = 1
endif
if ( static.runSystem == 0 ) then
    sErr = 0
endif
static.senderErr = sErr
// HIGH-LEVEL WARNING: warns the operator (latched -> UI popup); the feed cut on
// yEvapHigh itself (FeedFollow) is separate -- NOT a hard trip. Clears on stop.
// NOT during PURGE (phase<2): an OVERFULL warm start legitimately reads HIGH at
// run start while the purge is actively draining it down to the mark -- no heat,
// no forward feed, nothing to warn about (it would stay latched the whole run).
if ( (static.yEvapHigh > 0.5) and (static.mvrPhase >= 2) ) then
    static.evapHighSec = static.evapHighSec + sdt
    static.evapHighClrT = 0
else
    static.evapHighSec = 0
    static.evapHighClrT = static.evapHighClrT + sdt
endif
hiWarn = static.evapHighWarn
// SWELL-QUALIFIED (rig 7/22): warn only in RUN with real recent feed -- boil
// swell walks the reading over the 2750 edge with the feed idle (cold-start
// boil onset hit raw 3150 with feed OFF; RUN froth surges stepped 2600->2900 at
// 5rpm). Froth is not overfill. The yEvapHigh FEED CUT stays unconditional.
if ( (static.evapHighSec > static.evapHighWarnS) and (static.mvrPhase >= 4) and (static.feedRecentLpm > static.feedWarnLpm) ) then
    hiWarn = 1
endif
// AUTO-CLEAR: non-high continuously for evapHighClrS -> the excursion is over,
// stop glowing (was latched until STOP; the startup expansion bob lit it every run)
if ( static.evapHighClrT > static.evapHighClrS ) then
    hiWarn = 0
endif
if ( static.runSystem == 0 ) then
    hiWarn = 0
endif
static.evapHighWarn = hiWarn

// static errors are used for indicators
static.evapPErr     = (evapPress    > static.maxEvapPress)
static.steamPErr    = (steamPress   > static.maxSteamPress)
static.vaporOutTErr = (vaporOutTemp > static.maxVaporOut)
// Superheat (wet-compression) protection ARMS only after superheat is first
// established, and stays armed (latched) until the system stops -- this avoids
// the cold-start deadlock AND the trip/un-trip oscillation at a fixed temp.
// wet-comp gates: at REAL speed (the *0.9-of-target alone bit us when the target
// itself was wound down to ~1000 -- 938rpm 'at target' is thin flow) AND with the
// evaporator AT TEMP (below set-5 the pipe TC reads transient garbage, not wet
// compression). DISARMS whenever the blower leaves at-speed (a restart ramp
// legitimately collapses superheat); re-arming needs superheat re-established.
shAtSpeed = (static.blowerCmdRpm >= (static.blowerRpmSafe * 0.9)) and (static.blowerCmdRpm >= static.blowerMinRpm)
shAtTemp = static.yEvapTemp >= (static.evapTempSetSafe - 5)
shArmed = static.shArmed
if ( (static.mvrPhase >= 4) and shAtSpeed and shAtTemp and (superHIn > (static.minSuperheat + 1.0)) ) then
    shArmed = 1
endif
if ( shAtSpeed == 0 ) then
    shArmed = 0
endif
if ( static.runSystem == 0 ) then
    shArmed = 0
endif
static.shArmed = shArmed
// DEBOUNCED + LATCHED: only a PERSISTENT superheat collapse at speed+temp is wet
// compression -- the reading swings at modest flow and brief dips are normal.
// ...and NOT while the element regulator is capping the duty: the cartridge is at
// ~200C and can't push more heat -- the sag is a capability limit, not liquid
// carryover (a 200C mesh can't be wet). Rig 7/13 second false trip: shT pinned 199,
// duty 0.05, superheat drifted 6 -> -1 over 90s -> tripped. Real wet comp COOLS the
// mesh, the regulator releases, duty rises, and the sag then counts.
if ( static.runSystem and shArmed and (static.mvrPhase >= 4) and shAtSpeed and shAtTemp and (static.shElemLim < 0.5) and (superHIn < static.minSuperheat) ) then
    static.superHSec = static.superHSec + sdt
else
    static.superHSec = 0
endif
sHE = static.superHErr
if ( static.superHSec > static.superHFaultS ) then
    sHE = 1
endif
// AUTO-RESTART (rig 7/22): tripped -> blower+heat cut -> flow stops -> the sag
// clears; after shAutoRstS clear the latch and let the run RESUME IN PLACE
// (warm soft-restart, no purge). shArmed resets too, so the trip cannot re-fire
// until superheat is genuinely re-established at speed. Bounded attempts.
if ( sHE >= 0.5 ) then
    static.shRstT = static.shRstT + sdt
else
    static.shRstT = 0
endif
if ( (static.shAutoRstEn >= 0.5) and (sHE >= 0.5) and (static.shRstT > static.shAutoRstS) and (static.shRstCnt < static.shAutoRstMax) ) then
    sHE = 0
    static.shRstCnt = static.shRstCnt + 1
    static.superHSec = 0
    static.shArmed = 0
endif
if ( static.runSystem == 0 ) then
    sHE = 0
    static.shRstCnt = 0
endif
static.superHErr = sHE
// Cartridge overheat TRIPS (latched until runSystem=0). Makeup>makeupHtrMax =
// heater uncovered / feed overheat -> immediate shutdown. Superheat>superHtrMax
// = superheat-cartridge overheat -> immediate shutdown.
makeupOT = static.makeupHtrTrip
if ( static.yMakeupHtrTemp > static.makeupHtrMax ) then
    makeupOT = 1
endif
superOT = static.superHtrTrip
if ( static.ySuperHtrTemp > static.superHtrMax ) then
    superOT = 1
endif
if ( static.runSystem == 0 ) then
    makeupOT = 0
    superOT = 0
endif
static.makeupHtrTrip = makeupOT
static.superHtrTrip = superOT
trip = 0
trip = trip or static.evapPErr
trip = trip or static.steamPErr
trip = trip or static.vaporOutTErr
trip = trip or flood
trip = trip or static.evapLevelErr
trip = trip or static.senderErr
trip = trip or static.purgeErr
trip = trip or static.superHErr 
trip = trip or makeupOT
trip = trip or superOT
static.trip = trip

// heat only after the PRIME phase has charged the evaporator (phase>=HEAT=2)
heatOK = static.runSystem and (trip == 0) and (static.mvrPhase >= 3)
static.heatOK = heatOK
"DO:HeaterEnable" = heatOK
"DO:Alarm" = trip

expressions.name: SuperheatControl
MakeupControl
expressions.expression:
// Makeup/boiling heater PI -> DO:MakeupHtr PWM duty 0..1 (gated by heatOK).
err = static.evapTempSetSafe - static.yEvapTemp
iPrev = static.makeupI
i = iPrev
duty = 0
if ( static.heatOK ) then
    i = iPrev + static.kiMakeup * err * static.dtReal
    i = clamp(i, 0, 1)
    duty = static.kpMakeup * err + i
    if ( duty > 1 ) then
        duty = 1
        i = iPrev
    endif
    if ( duty < 0 ) then
        duty = 0
        i = iPrev
    endif
    // ELEMENT-TEMP FOLD-BACK: if the cartridge TC climbs past the soft limit (violent
    // boil / local dry-out) scale the duty DOWN so water re-wets the element -- never
    // below the keep-warm floor, and never ABOVE what the PI asked. The hard
    // makeupHtrMax trip (Interlocks) is the backstop if this can't hold it.
    if ( static.yMakeupHtrTemp > static.makeupHtrSoft ) then
        fold = clamp(1 - (static.yMakeupHtrTemp - static.makeupHtrSoft) / static.makeupHtrFoldBand, 0, 1)
        foldDuty = duty * fold
        if ( foldDuty < static.makeupHtrMinDuty ) then
            foldDuty = static.makeupHtrMinDuty
        endif
        if ( foldDuty > duty ) then
            foldDuty = duty
        endif
        duty = foldDuty
        i = iPrev
    endif
else
    i = 0
endif
static.makeupI = i
static.makeupDuty = duty
"DO:MakeupHtr" = duty

expressions.name: BlowerControl
expressions.expression:
// Blower (VFD) SOFT-START: OFF below blowerStartTemp (no vapor to pump on a cold
// evaporator), then ramp from blowerRampRpm0 at blowerRampRpmS to the target. The
// old pressure-guard backoff was removed: the level gauge vent now ties to the evap
// vapor space (connected-vessel manometer), so suction no longer lies the gauge.
// FLAT single-level ifs: deep if/else nesting miscompiles in the transpiler.
// START/STOP HYSTERESIS: the pipe TC only reads true vapor temp WITH flow and
// hovers near 90 in marginal regimes -- a single 90C run-gate limit-cycled the
// blower on the rig (start >=90, then a dip under 90 cut it, stagnant pipe warmed
// back, restart, repeat). Start at blowerStartTemp; once the blower is RUNNING it
// only stops if the temp truly collapses below blowerStopTemp.
gateT = static.blowerStartTemp
if ( static.blowerCmdRpm > 0 ) then
    gateT = static.blowerStopTemp
endif
run = static.runSystem and (static.trip == 0) and (static.mvrPhase >= 3) and (static.yEvapTemp >= gateT)
sdt = static.dtReal
if ( static.simEnable ) then
    sdt = static.dtReal * static.simSpeed
endif
// target = the production setpoint, EXCEPT while the startup vent is open with the
// evaporator at temp: BOOST to ventBoostRpm so the vapor mass flow actually heats
// the discharge path and closes the vent (1500 was too thin -- VaporOut crawled).
// The instant the vent closes the target drops back and cmd clamps down with it.
target = static.blowerRpmSafe
if ( (static.ventOpen >= 0.5) and (static.yEvapTemp >= (static.evapTempSetSafe - 3)) and (static.ventBoostRpm > target) ) then
    target = static.ventBoostRpm
endif
cmd = static.blowerCmdRpm
if ( run and (cmd < static.blowerRampRpm0) ) then
    cmd = static.blowerRampRpm0
endif
// two-stage ramp: crawl while warming (thin vapor), step on it once the
// evaporator is at temp -- the boil can keep up and crawling just delays
// production + superheat (rig feedback 7/13).
rr = static.blowerRampRpmS
if ( static.yEvapTemp >= (static.evapTempSetSafe - 3) ) then
    rr = static.blowerRampHotS
endif
if ( run and (cmd < target) ) then
    cmd = cmd + rr * sdt
endif
if ( cmd > target ) then
    cmd = target
endif
cmd = clamp(cmd, 0, static.blowerMaxRpm)
if ( run == 0 ) then
    cmd = 0
endif
static.blowerCmdRpm = cmd
static.vfdRpmRead = "VFD:VFD 1".RPM
"VFD:VFD 1.ENABLE" = run
if ( run ) then
    "VFD:VFD 1.RPM" = cmd
    "VFD:VFD 1.DIR" = 0
else
    "VFD:VFD 1.ENABLE" = 0
    "VFD:VFD 1.RPM" = 0
endif
bypassV = (static.surgeThresh - static.deltaT) * static.surgeGain
bypassV = clamp(bypassV, 0, 10)
if ( run == 0 ) then
    bypassV = 0
endif
static.bypassV = bypassV
"AO:BypassValve" = bypassV

expressions.name: FeedwaterControl
expressions.expression:
// Feedwater peristaltic (stepper) dosing; gated by runSystem & not trip.
// Velocity is driven as a LEVEL (0 = stop) so every run/stop transition is a
// real value change and re-triggers the drive. (A separate STOP command would
// leave VELOCITY cached at the run value, so a re-run after a stop would be
// deduped and never re-fire -- the motor would stay still.)

// PRIME phase doses a fixed prime rpm (dead-reckon fill); RUN uses the
// mass-balance feedRpmSet (FeedFollow). Velocity is a LEVEL (0=stop). feedCmdRpm
// is the ACTUAL command (the sim reads it so the prime fill shows in inventory).
phase = static.mvrPhase
run = (static.runSystem and (static.trip == 0) and (phase >= 1)) or (static.emptying >= 0.5)
vel = 0
if ( phase == 1 ) then
    vel = 0 - static.purgeRevRpm
endif
if ( phase == 2 ) then
    vel = static.feedPrimeRpm
endif
if ( static.emptying >= 0.5 ) then
    vel = 0 - static.purgeRevRpm
endif
if ( phase >= 3 ) then
    vel = static.feedRpmSafe
endif
if ( run == 0 ) then
    vel = 0
endif
static.feedCmdRpm = vel
"STEP:Feed.ENABLE" = run
"STEP:Feed.VELOCITY" = vel

expressions.name: CondensatePump
DemisterDrain
expressions.expression:
// Demister drain peristaltic pump. DemisterWater is a WET/DRY sensor (0/5V) at the ~80cc
// height: wet = water reached it. Pump ON when wet; then run a MIN time (demisterDrainRunS)
// to clear it below the sensor before stopping -- a single wet/dry threshold would chatter
// otherwise. So it empties the demister, then waits (minutes when hot) to refill. Gated by run.
dt = static.dtReal
cdt = dt
if ( static.simEnable ) then
    cdt = dt * static.simSpeed
endif
drain = static.demisterDrainOn
if ( static.yDemisterWater > 0.5 ) then
    drain = 1
endif
if ( drain >= 0.5 ) then
    static.demisterDrainSec = static.demisterDrainSec + cdt
endif
if ( (static.demisterDrainSec >= static.demisterDrainRunS) and (static.yDemisterWater < 0.5) ) then
    drain = 0
    static.demisterDrainSec = 0
endif
if ( static.runSystem == 0 ) then
    drain = 0
    static.demisterDrainSec = 0
endif
static.demisterDrainOn = drain
"DO:DemisterDrain" = drain

expressions.name: monitorMotor
expressions.expression:
// Read the VFD for motor performance values

rpm = "VFD:VFD 1".RPM
voltage = "VFD:VFD 1".VOLTAGE
current = "VFD:VFD 1".CURRENT
powerkw = "VFD:VFD 1".POWER
torque  = "VFD:VFD 1".TORQUE
accel   = "VFD:VFD 1.P0.12"
accelRaw = "VFD:VFD 1#0xF012"
sink    = "VFD:VFD 1.P07.06"
enable  = "VFD:VFD 1".ENABLE

static.vfdEnable  = enable
static.vfdOutVolt = voltage
static.vfdOutAmps = current
static.vfdOutPwr  = powerkw
static.vfdTorque  = torque
static.accel      = accel
static.accelraw   = accelRaw
static.sink       = sink

expressions.name: ProductionControl
FeedFollow
MVR System
expressions.expression:
// ===== MVR STARTUP SEQUENCE / STATE MACHINE =====
// IDLE -> PRIME -> HEAT -> RUN. PRIME fills the feed side to feedPrimeML (the
// dead-reckoned inventory feedInvEst, computed in CondensatePump) so the makeup
// heater is covered before heat; HEAT runs makeup to boiling; RUN hands to the
// closed-loop production control. heatOK and the blower are gated on phase>=HEAT
// so the element never dry-fires. A restart with the HX already charged skips
// straight through PRIME (feedInvEst already >= feedPrimeML).
static.runSystem = buttonVars.runSystem
runSystem = static.runSystem

// SIM RESET: snap the plant + control state back to cold/ambient startup
// (Reset button in the Sim panel -> static.simReset). One-shot, self-clearing;
// only acts while simulating.
if ( static.simReset >= 0.5 ) then
    if ( static.simEnable >= 0.5 ) then
        static.simEvapTemp = static.simAmbient
        static.simEvapPress = 14.7
        static.simSteamPress = 14.7
        static.simVaporIn = static.simAmbient
        static.simVaporOut = static.simAmbient
        static.simSteamChest = static.simAmbient
        static.simHXbottom = static.simAmbient
        static.simCondTemp = static.simAmbient
        static.simFeedTemp = static.simFeedSupply
        static.simSuperheat = 0
        static.simBlowerRpm = 0
        static.simProd = 0
        static.simEvapInv = 0
        static.simCondVol = 0
        static.simCondHold = 0
        static.simCondHigh = 0
        static.simCondLow = 0
        static.simCondFlow = 0
        static.simCondLevel = 0
        static.simDemisterWater = 0
        static.demisterDrainOn = 0
        static.simDemisterFlood = 0
        static.simClock = 0
        static.simHeatLoss = 0
        static.simHeatIn = 0
        static.mvrPhase = 0
        static.feedInvEst = 0
        static.levelStepPrev = 0 - 1
        static.levelBiasLpm = 0
        static.feedLevelTrim = 0
        static.purgeOutML = 0
        static.feedCmdRpm = 0
        static.prodMeas = 0
        static.makeupI = 0
        static.superI = 0
        static.condPumpOn = 0
        static.condCycleSec = 0
        static.condBatchRaw = 0
        static.condRateLpm = 0
        static.condHaveRate = 0
        static.condLowFlowSec = 0
        static.condPumpRunSec = 0
        static.condPumpFault = 0
static.simCondTotal = 0
static.condTotalAtStart = 0
static.condRateWinT = 0
static.condRateWinTot = 0
        static.shArmed = 0
        static.condCalFactor = 1.0
        static.condFillRaw = 0
        static.condProduct = 0
        static.condVolEst = 0
        static.prevCondHigh = 0
        static.prevCondLow = 0
        static.blowerRpmSet = 1500
        static.simMakeupHtrTemp = static.simAmbient
        static.simSuperHtrTemp = static.simAmbient
        static.makeupHtrTrip = 0
        static.superHtrTrip = 0
        static.ventOpen = 0
        static.condLiquid = 0
    endif
    static.simReset = 0
endif
// SAFETY: accept productionSet only if in [0, prodSetMax]; otherwise IGNORE it
// and keep the last valid target (prodSetSafe). Guards against a fat-fingered
// value (e.g. 100 instead of 0.1) driving the blower controller wild.
if ( static.productionSet >= 0 and static.productionSet <= static.prodSetMax ) then
    static.prodSetSafe = static.productionSet
endif
if ( static.superheatSet >= 0 and static.superheatSet <= static.superheatSetMax ) then
    static.superheatSetSafe = static.superheatSet
endif
if ( static.evapTempSet >= static.evapTempSetMin and static.evapTempSet <= static.evapTempSetMax ) then
    static.evapTempSetSafe = static.evapTempSet
endif
if ( static.blowerRpmSet >= 0 and static.blowerRpmSet <= static.blowerMaxRpm ) then
    static.blowerRpmSafe = static.blowerRpmSet
endif
if ( static.feedRpmSet >= 0 and static.feedRpmSet <= static.feedRpmMax ) then
    static.feedRpmSafe = static.feedRpmSet
endif

// ---- EMPTY SYSTEM / SHUTDOWN (maintenance): Button widgets in VARIABLE mode named
// 'emptySystem' or 'shutdown' reverse-pump the system dry WITHOUT starting a run: to
// sender bottom + purgeExtraML (or the purgeMaxML backstop), then stop themselves.
// SHUTDOWN = heaters provably OFF + drain: with Run OFF, heatOK=0 already forces
// HeaterEnable and both heater PWMs to 0 and the blower is disabled, so the only
// action left is the pump-out. Run must be turned OFF first -- the request is
// IGNORED while running. Toggle the button off to re-arm. Hitting RUN aborts it.
emptyReq = 0
if ( (buttonVars.emptySystem >= 0.5) or (buttonVars.shutdown >= 0.5) ) then
    emptyReq = 1
endif
if ( emptyReq < 0.5 ) then
    static.emptying = 0
    static.emptyDone = 0
endif
if ( (emptyReq >= 0.5) and (runSystem == 0) and (static.emptyDone < 0.5) and (static.emptying < 0.5) ) then
    static.emptying = 1
    static.purgeOutML = 0
    static.purgeZeroML = 0 - 1
endif
if ( runSystem >= 0.5 ) then
    static.emptying = 0
endif
if ( static.emptying >= 0.5 ) then
    if ( static.senderOK and (static.yEvapLevRaw <= 0) and (static.purgeZeroML < 0) ) then
        static.purgeZeroML = static.purgeOutML
    endif
    emptyFin = 0
    if ( (static.purgeZeroML >= 0) and (static.purgeOutML >= (static.purgeZeroML + static.purgeExtraML)) ) then
        emptyFin = 1
    endif
    if ( static.purgeOutML >= static.emptyMaxML ) then
        emptyFin = 1
    endif
    if ( emptyFin ) then
        static.emptying = 0
        static.emptyDone = 1
        static.feedInvEst = 0
    endif
endif

IDLE = 0
PURGE = 1
PRIME = 2
HEAT = 3
RUN = 4
phase = static.mvrPhase

if ( runSystem == 0 ) then
    phase = IDLE
    static.purgeErr = 0
    static.purgeStallSec = 0
endif

SWITCH phase
   CASE IDLE
      if ( runSystem ) then
          phase = PURGE
          static.blowerCmdRpm = 0
          static.purgeOutML = 0
          static.purgeZeroML = 0 - 1
          static.purgeStallSec = 0
          static.purgeLvlPrev = static.yEvapLevRaw
          static.prodWinT = 0
          static.prodWinTot = static.yCondTotal   // fresh production window per run
          static.prodInWinT = 0
          static.prodInFeedMl = 0
          static.prodInLvl0 = static.feedInvEst
          static.prodInHave = 0
          static.feedStallML = 0
          if ( static.senderOK ) then
              // SEED the inventory estimate from the SENDER at run start -- never assume
              // dry. The fusion keeps blending it with yEvapLevRaw from here on.
              static.feedInvEst = static.yEvapLevRaw
              static.levelStepPrev = static.yEvapLevRaw
          endif
          // WARM START: the sender already shows water at a KNOWN plateau -> pump down
          // until it has dropped at least ONE plateau AND reads at/below the operating
          // mark (a restart from an OVERFULL shutdown keeps pumping to the mark). Every
          // drop crossing snaps feedInvEst to the edge midpoint (CondensatePump fusion) --
          // coming down from above, the LAST crossing is the 2600|2350 edge = the operating
          // mark itself -- so we start from a CALIBRATED level instead of purging to dry
          // and refilling (much faster restart).
          static.purgeWarm = 0
          static.purgeStartLvl = static.yEvapLevRaw
          if ( (static.purgeWarmEn >= 0.5) and static.senderOK and (static.yEvapLevRaw > 0) ) then
              static.purgeWarm = 1
          endif
      endif
   CASE PURGE
      // Pump out until the CALIBRATED level sender reads MINIMUM (plateau 0 = below
      // ~100mL, well under the inlet tube) -- no more blind full-2L pump-out (that was
      // for the sensorless days and made startup crawl). If the sender is faulted
      // (senderOK=0), fall back to the blind dead-reckon backstop volume.
      // WATCHDOG: while purging with a good sender, the level MUST keep dropping.
      // Once the sender reads BOTTOM the watchdog DISARMS (the level is legitimately
      // flat during the below-float overrun) and the bottom mark is captured ONCE per
      // purge (a float-bob flicker must not restart the overrun window).
      sdt = static.dtReal
      if ( static.simEnable ) then
          sdt = static.dtReal * static.simSpeed
      endif
      if ( static.senderOK ) then
          if ( (static.yEvapLevRaw <= 0) and (static.purgeZeroML < 0) ) then
              static.purgeZeroML = static.purgeOutML
          endif
          if ( static.purgeZeroML >= 0 ) then
              static.purgeStallSec = 0
          else
              if ( static.yEvapLevRaw < static.purgeLvlPrev ) then
                  static.purgeLvlPrev = static.yEvapLevRaw
                  static.purgeStallSec = 0
              else
                  if ( static.yEvapLevRaw > static.purgeLvlPrev ) then
                      static.purgeLvlPrev = static.yEvapLevRaw
                  endif
                  static.purgeStallSec = static.purgeStallSec + sdt
              endif
              if ( static.purgeStallSec > static.purgeStallS ) then
                  static.purgeErr = 1
              endif
          endif
      endif
      // WARM-START completion: dropped at least one plateau (the crossing snapped
      // feedInvEst to the edge midpoint -- CondensatePump runs earlier this tick) AND
      // the reading is at/below the operating mark, so an overfull restart pumps on
      // down to the mark first. KEEP the snapped estimate and move on. A sender fault
      // mid-warm-purge can't fire this; the purgeMaxML backstop below (and the stall
      // watchdog) still cover it.
      if ( (static.purgeWarm >= 0.5) and static.senderOK and (static.yEvapLevRaw < static.purgeStartLvl) and (static.yEvapLevRaw < static.evapMidMark) ) then
          phase = PRIME
      endif
      if ( (static.purgeWarm < 0.5) and (static.purgeZeroML >= 0) and (static.purgeOutML >= (static.purgeZeroML + static.purgeExtraML)) ) then
          phase = PRIME
          if ( static.senderOK ) then
              static.feedInvEst = static.yEvapLevRaw   // trust the SENDER (reads 0 here), never fiat-assume
          else
              static.feedInvEst = 0
          endif
      endif
      if ( (phase == PURGE) and (static.purgeOutML >= static.purgeMaxML) ) then
          phase = PRIME
          if ( static.senderOK ) then
              static.feedInvEst = static.yEvapLevRaw
          else
              static.feedInvEst = 0
          endif
      endif
   CASE PRIME
      // fill to the EvapLow mark (heater covered) and CONFIRM with the low sensor,
      // then heat. Primed-but-dry (sensor never wets) latches evapLevelErr.
      if ( static.feedInvEst >= static.feedPrimeML and static.yEvapLow ) then
          phase = HEAT
      endif
   CASE HEAT
      // makeup heater warms the charge; advance to RUN once near boiling.
      // Seed prodMeas at the target so the blower controller doesn't spike (and
      // overshoot production / drain the evaporator) when RUN first engages.
      // feed ramps the level to the operating mark (EvapMid) during warm-up; go to RUN
      // once near boiling AND the operating level is reached (EvapMid wet).
      // advance on temp + level NEAR the mark (mark - fillStopML): the HEAT fill
      // stops early (cold-water expansion overshot the mid switch into the high
      // warn every startup); RUN's own level control finishes the approach.
      if ( (static.yEvapTemp > (static.evapTempSetSafe - 3)) and (static.yEvapLevRaw >= (static.evapMidMark - static.fillStopML)) ) then
          phase = RUN
          // HONEST prodMeas at RUN entry (rig 7/15): the old prodSetSafe seed showed
          // the SETPOINT as if measured whenever no measurement existed yet (glued to
          // productionSet after a recompile), overwrote a live measurement on warm
          // restarts, and parked prodMeas above the stall vent-pulse threshold so the
          // air-purge rescue could never fire. The production integral is gated on
          // condHaveRate, so a low prodMeas cannot spike the blower -- seed with the
          // real measurement, or 0 when none exists.
          static.prodMeas = static.condRateLpm * static.condHaveRate
      endif
   CASE RUN
      phase = RUN
ENDSWITCH
static.mvrPhase = phase
static.mvrState = phase

expressions.name: PowerMeter
expressions.expression:
// ===== POWER METER: instantaneous W + kWh totalizer =====
// Heaters: rated W x PWM duty (the duty IS the power fraction). Blower: the
// VFD's own output-power report (vfdOutPwr, W, via monitorMotor .POWER -- 0 in
// sim). Small loads: flat ratings gated by their run states. energyKWh
// accumulates on sim-scaled time like every other integrator; zero it from a
// Static Var widget to start a measurement window.
cdt = static.dtReal
if ( static.simEnable ) then
    cdt = cdt * static.simSpeed
endif
pw = static.pwrBaseW
pw = pw + static.makeupDuty * static.pwrMakeupW
pw = pw + static.superDuty * static.pwrSuperW
pw = pw + static.vfdOutPwr
if ( static.condPumpOn >= 0.5 ) then
    pw = pw + static.pwrCondW
endif
if ( static.demisterDrainOn >= 0.5 ) then
    pw = pw + static.pwrMistW
endif
if ( (static.feedCmdRpm > 1) or (static.feedCmdRpm < (0 - 1)) ) then
    pw = pw + static.pwrFeedW
endif
static.powerW = pw
// SPECIFIC ENERGY window: buttonVars.resetEnergyCalcs (Button widget, VARIABLE
// mode, on the dashboard) zeroes the energy AND the window's product totalizer
// together -- press+release at RUN entry and the pair reads kWh-per-L for the
// run so far. Product accumulates CALIBRATED meter flow (same cal as batches).
if ( buttonVars.resetEnergyCalcs >= 0.5 ) then
    static.energyKWh = 0
    static.energyProdL = 0
endif
static.energyKWh = static.energyKWh + pw * cdt / 3600000
static.energyProdL = static.energyProdL + static.yCondFlow * static.condCalFactor * cdt / 60
// guard: no meaningful ratio until ~50ml of product has landed in the window
static.specKWhL = 0
if ( static.energyProdL > 0.05 ) then
    static.specKWhL = static.energyKWh / static.energyProdL
endif

expressions.name: MVRSim
